channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Leandro Barbosa | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Leandro Barbosa from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Leandro Barbosa
item.description:
Klay Thompson on his defense:

“Going against guys like Leandro Barbosa has helped me. He's still so quick... I don't plan on being a slouch on (the defensive) end.”

Klay Thompson on Leandro Barbosa, Nov 23, 2021. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Leandro Barbosa
item.description:
Drew Shiller:Steve Kerr on Warriors assistant coach Leandro Barbosa:

“He can still play. If we needed him, and we had to sign him to a 10-day (contract), he could go right now and help us win a game. Guy's in amazing shape.”

Steve Kerr on Leandro Barbosa, Jan 10, 2021. Source: Twitter @DrewShiller.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Leandro Barbosa
item.description:
Wes Goldberg:Kerr on Leandro Barbosa, now on the coaching staff:

“If we needed him and had to sign him to a 10-day, he could go go right now and help us win a game.”

Steve Kerr on Leandro Barbosa, Jan 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @wcgoldberg.

item.title: Peter Guber on Leandro Barbosa, Andrew Bogut, Nemanja Nedovic, Festus Ezeli, Ognjen Kuzmic
item.description:
“The following is a great example of the growth of our league. There are 101 international players on NBA opening night rosters, which represents 22% of the league. We have five [5] international players on our roster (33%), which includes Andrew Bogut, Leandro Barbosa, Festus Ezeli, Ognjen Kuzmic and Nemanja Nedovic. We've come a long way…”

Peter Guber on Leandro Barbosa, Andrew Bogut, Nemanja Nedovic, Festus Ezeli, Ognjen Kuzmic, Oct 28, 2014. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Jeff Hornacek on Leandro Barbosa
item.description:
Paul Coro:Hornacek on Barbosa's shoulder sprain:

“He thought he'd be able to play today & then we talked to him & he said he'd be able to play Sunday”

Jeff Hornacek on Leandro Barbosa, Jan 17, 2014. Source: Twitter @paulcoro.

item.title: Steve Nash on Leandro Barbosa
item.description:
Steve Nash, according to Leandro Barbosa, according to Steve Nash, plays soccer like he plays basketball

“Leandro Barbosa, my former teammate [with the Phoenix Suns] . . . says I play soccer exactly how I play basketball,”

Steve Nash on Leandro Barbosa, Jun 12, 2013. Source: Sulia.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Leandro Barbosa
item.description:
Rondo on Leandro Barbosa, who is expected to join the Celtics for Saturday’s game:

“It’s big for me, I won’t have to play as many minutes and take a toll on my body. And with Barbosa in the game, the speed is going to continue to stay the same when I go out. He can create his own shots, make plays for teammates, and also can score the ball. I think it’s a great pickup.”

Rajon Rondo on Leandro Barbosa, Oct 20, 2012. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Danny Granger on Leandro Barbosa
item.description:
Here’s Granger on the layup attempt by Barbosa:

“If I was on him, I would have took his head off and I would have been suspended for a game for a flagrant foul. Stuff like that will set in the back of your head the next time we play Toronto. We don’t play them again but I was on him, I would have taken his neck off.”

Danny Granger on Leandro Barbosa, Mar 12, 2011. Source: The Score.
